summary: Iter89 review-request testing (backend + frontend). All requested flows verified end-to-end EXCEPT the manager-home opening-cost banner, blocked by an overly strict permission on GET /api/inventory/rolls-without-cost. Regression tests pass. Backend + UI-integration confirmed for Makloon staged receipt (partial hold + absorption on final GRN close), opening-cost banner on admin home, and amendment _sync_backorders.

critical.issue: Requires `product.create` permission (backend/routers/inventory.py line 314). Manager role does not have product.create — endpoint returns 403 `Permission ditolak: product.create` when hit as manager@kainnusantara.id. Consequence: OpeningCostBanner never renders on manager-home even though the review-request explicitly requires it (`login manager@... → banner shows when rolls exist`). Fix: this GET should require a *read* permission (e.g. `inventory.read` or role_home visibility), not `product.create` (which is a write cap). Same request also fails silently for finance/sales who might reasonably see the go-live banner. PATCH /opening-cost may keep product.create for write.

integration_issues.issue: Banner absent because upstream API 403s (see backend critical). Component OpeningCostBanner swallows the error and renders nothing — consider surfacing a subtle warning or (better) fix permission on the API.
